verdict.rationale: Whisper's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (openai/whisper), installable via pip, and exposes a readable Python package including lower-level functions such as detect_language() and decode(), so users can read the code. However, nothing in the pack states which license covers it; the only hint is a community remark that loosely groups Whisper with other open-source STT models. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement (e.g., a LICENSE file or license name), first-party confirmation that both code and model weights are openly licensed, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
